dedupe_keys.name: comptage routier sur la voirie departementale en haute garonne

description: Comptage routier sur la voirie départementale en Haute-Garonne is a dataset listed in Open Data Haute-Garonne, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil départemental de la Haute-Garonne. Le comptage routier permet d'évaluer le trafic des véhicules, voitures et poids lourds, sur les routes départementales (RD) de la Haute-Garonne. Ces données sont recueillies et analysées par la Direction des routes du Département pour étudier les conditions de circulation et les niveaux de trafic sur certains sites du territoire. Coverage: Haute-Garonne. The portal files it under Déplacements. Its keywords are Comptage routier, Routes départementales, Trafic routier, Voirie, Circulation, Infrastructures routières. The portal shows 5,768 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-haute-garonne-fr-portal.
